trapsHit: The 'Add task' role-name selector matched two elements (the inline per-project row plus the global plus_add_button); disambiguated by CSS class.

A stray click using loc=role:textbox[name='Task name'] matched the currently-open 'Bat fix' task's own editable title field (not the empty Quick Add composer field), because both share the same accessible name. Caught this before typing by checking document.activeElement's current text content (it read 'Bat fix', not empty) and aborted/Escaped without typing -- no edit was made. Re-opened Quick Add fresh and verified the field's textContent was empty before typing 'tod'.

Escaping out of the Quick Add composer with unsaved text triggers a 'Discard unsaved changes?' confirmation dialog; had to click 'Discard' explicitly rather than assuming a single Escape fully closed and discarded the draft.
